info.title: API-DocTest-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve detailed information about ongoing and completed checkouts in the ecommerce platform. It serves as an essential resource for developers looking to integrate and monitor the checkout process, ensuring they can provide customers with an efficient shopping experience. Typical consumers of this API include frontend applications and enterprise systems that require real-time access to checkout data for analytics, order management, or customer service purposes. This API is designed to streamline data access and improve operational workflows related to cart checkouts.

get.summary: Initiate the checkout process for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to start the checkout process for items in their shopping cart. It retrieves necessary information and prepares the user for payment and order confirmation steps.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating the checkout process. This body should contain the cart details required for completing the checkout.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the checkout operations on the shopping cart.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number assigned to the checkout operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the checkout process.

state.description: Current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the checkout operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the checkout entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the checkout entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing details related to the audit of the checkout operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request.
